title: Creating Graphics With AI+Blender For Your Game And Where To Draw The Line
author: bingewavecinema
selftext:
Tomorrow talk at the festival AI Gaming Festival is [Intro To Making Graphics With AI + Blender](https://www.glitch.fun/gameshows/9eadde86-a1b2-4882-86e4-a3e9e2e08814/schedule/01a0542f-17f4-726d-a334-91ddc8d4bf4c/standalone)

If you are new to game development, the session will go over how to create graphics by using LLM (Claude Code or Codex), along with a lot of mistakes to avoid when creating those graphics.

Some of the honest take, AI can get your graphics 80% to 90% of the way, definitely enough for a good prototype or demo. Where it falls short, is that final polish piece where AI starts to "spin almost indefinitely" at those final polishing points, and that's when you're better off hiring someone to finish the  bits.
